reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the assigned needs, matches capabilities by exact need text, and emits direct coverage only when a capability_id exists. The assigned output correctly marks n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r06, and n06-r08 as direct, while n06-r01 and n06-r07 remain unsupported.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This makes supported/direct capabilities rank before genuinely unsupported market needs and produces contradictory priority records where direct coverage is marked unsupported true while unsupported coverage is marked unsupported false.

synthesize_recommendation deterministically takes the first retained priority and chooses prioritize when its unsupported flag is true. The bad recommendation content is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag supplied by prioritize_needs, not localized to this function.
